decisions.reason: Choosing a set of drawings as the delivery package does not change the established drawing setup or numbering conventions.
The source selects the manufacturing-drawing package but does not cancel or alter the independently requested 3D model or its file formats.
The delivery of a set of drawings does not establish or change any requirement concerning dimension annotation accuracy.
The delivery-package decision does not change the bushing arrangement, rod guidance, clearances, retention, or hole configuration.
The choice to deliver a set of drawings does not alter the welded-lug geometry, fabrication sequence, angular spacing, or face finishing.
